limitations: All ten portraits use the same completely fictional older adult woman; exact age is a prompt setting, not medical/biometric verification or a requirement for users.
Broad visible identity/gray-hair/wrinkle continuity was subjectively checked; no biometric guarantee, all-gender/age/hair-type coverage or real-customer likeness test.
Indexed 512x768 PNG previews have some texture/gradient quantization; not print-quality delivery promises.
Veteran sample is fictional and unmarked; no real service history was verified.
No real customer photo, payment/OAuth test, production signed-reference transport or WorkBuddy host/platform acceptance was validated.
